How it works

Active immersion, step by step

Pick a place

Spin the globe, pick a city, find your spot on the map — a café, a clinic, a park. Each one is a real situation, ready to step into.

Meet a local

Practice real conversations. Say whatever you want, however you want, out loud — and they answer in real time. Every local has a personality of their own, and the regulars become friends.

Speak with backup

Not sure what to say? Get a suggested phrase, tap any word, or replay it slower. Take your time and take the help you need — it's a lot at first, and that's exactly what the tools are for.

Leave with progress

LingoLooper tracks your fluency and vocabulary as you talk, unlocks harder levels as you grow, and builds word lists from the ones you want to remember. Every conversation, a little more ground gained.

Questions, answered

Good to know

Is LingoLooper a free app?

LingoLooper is free to download, and you can try your first conversations without creating an account or starting a trial subscription.

To continue practicing after that, you need a subscription in the app. Depending on your country and app store offer, you may see a free trial, and the trial length can vary. The exact price, trial, and renewal terms are always shown before you confirm.

Real-time AI conversation, speech recognition, feedback, and immersive practice are expensive to run. We charge for a subscription so LingoLooper can stay premium, reliable, and ad-free.

We want a premium learning experience that stays accessible to everyone. If a subscription is genuinely out of reach, write to us at contact@lingolooper.com and we'll find a solution for you.

Do I need to create an account to try LingoLooper?

No. You can try your first conversations without creating an account or starting a trial subscription.

Create or register your account when you want to keep your loop history, save learner stats, and continue on any supported device.

What languages can I learn with LingoLooper?

LingoLooper currently supports 29 learnable languages: Arabic, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese.

See the roadmap
Is LingoLooper suitable for me?

If you have some basic knowledge of your target language and you've hit a wall with other apps, LingoLooper is your way past the common obstacles with a more practical, more effective approach.

Beginners benefit too, thanks to dynamic in-game suggestions that help you say what you mean before you can say it on your own.

How is LingoLooper different from other language apps?

LingoLooper is voice-first, built around real-time AI conversation practice. It simulates moving abroad and picking up the language by talking with locals in an immersive 3D world, so you build the speaking skills you'll actually use in real life.

Will LingoLooper replace my courses or tutor?

LingoLooper recreates the experience of living abroad through full language immersion, which makes it a great complement to in-person courses and tutor sessions. The best approach is the combination that feels right for you.

Can I learn more than one language at a time?

Absolutely. With LingoLooper you're free to learn as many languages as you like. Your ambition is the only limit.

How do I cancel my subscription or trial?

Your subscription or trial is managed by the app store where you started it: Apple App Store or Google Play. Open your Apple or Google account subscriptions, find LingoLooper, and choose Cancel subscription.

Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription or trial. After you cancel, you usually keep access until the end of your current trial or billing period.

Cancel through Apple Cancel through Google Play
Can I get a refund?

If something went wrong, contact us at contact@lingolooper.com and we'll help you find the right refund path.

Refund eligibility depends on the app store, your payment method, country or region, timing, and the store's current policy. Purchases processed by Apple or Google Play are reviewed under their refund policies, so we cannot guarantee the outcome.

Request a refund from Apple Google Play refund policy
Does LingoLooper work offline?

No. LingoLooper needs an internet connection because conversations, speech recognition, feedback, and progress sync run online.

You can use Wi-Fi or mobile data. For the best experience, use a stable connection.

Why doesn't LingoLooper pick up what I am saying?

Speech recognition depends on the sound LingoLooper receives. Microphone quality, a covered microphone, distance from the device, background noise, music, wind, or other people talking can all make it harder to understand you.

Try speaking in a quieter place, keep your device microphone clear, and check that microphone permission is enabled for LingoLooper.

If it still feels off, open Advanced Settings in the app and try a different speech input model. Some voices, accents, devices, and noisy rooms work better with one model than another.

How often should I use LingoLooper to improve?

Start with micro-sessions around 10 minutes, roughly two loops a day, to build the habit and see real progress within your first weeks. Consistency is what gets you to mastery; once daily looping feels natural, go longer and deeper to advance faster.

Are my conversations recorded?

LingoLooper needs to process your voice to make the experience work: your speech has to be transcribed, reviewed, and turned into feedback while you talk with an avatar.

We treat your conversations as private conversations. They are not made public, and we may keep conversation audio for a limited time only for user experience and quality-assurance purposes, such as investigating bugs, checking speech recognition quality, and improving the speaking experience.

As with any AI conversation product, we recommend not sharing sensitive personal information in your conversations.

How do I save my progress?

To keep your loop history and learner stats, register your account: open your Profile, tap Register this account, then sign in with Google, Apple, or email.

Starting a subscription does not automatically register your profile, so register separately if you want your progress connected to an account.

Use the same account to pick up your learning on any supported device.

Can I track my progress?

Yes. LingoLooper evaluates your performance after each conversation and gives you personalized feedback on vocabulary, style, grammar, and fluency. You can revisit the transcript of any conversation and save new words and phrases to your vocabulary tracker.

What does my fluency score mean?

Fluency measures how easily you turn ideas into speech. We look at the pause before you answer and how fast you speak to calculate your current score.

Tap your fluency score to see your response time, speaking duration, and speech rate.

What does the vocabulary score measure?

Vocabulary measures the sophistication of your speech: the length of your responses, plus the frequency and diversity of the words you use.

Tap your vocabulary score to see how many words you used, how many were unique, and how many came from in-game suggestions.

Can I share feedback or suggestions?

Yes. There's a built-in feedback feature at the end of every loop where you can rate your experience and write in your ideas. We also have a growing Discord community that talks directly with the founders.

Join the Discord
How often is LingoLooper updated?

We work hard to ship new updates and features regularly. To follow along, or add your own ideas, check out our public roadmap.

See the roadmap

Yes. Join our Discord to swap tips with other learners, share feedback, and talk product directly with the founders, Dani and Simon. Follow the link and say hello. We'd love to meet you.
